label: Cereals
rationale: HCAT level-4 cereals branch (wheat, rye, barley, oats, maize, rice, triticale, millet/sorghum, other cereals) maps directly to brief archetype 10 'Cereals & Grains'.

label: Pulses (dry legumes)
rationale: Beans, chickpeas, peas, lupins. The brief's fallback archetype explicitly names 'Mixed / Pulses' as its representative crop.

label: Potatoes
rationale: Irrigated horticultural tuber crop; grouped with high-value vegetables (archetype 50).

label: Sweet potatoes
rationale: Irrigated horticultural tuber crop; grouped with high-value vegetables (archetype 50).

label: Oilseed and industrial crops
rationale: Rapeseed, sunflower, other oilseeds: arable field crops with no dedicated brief archetype, hence fallback.

label: Aromatic, medicinal and culinary plants
rationale: Herbs and spices (incl. piper pepper) are high-value horticulture; the longer prefix overrides the oilseed/industrial parent 330106.

label: Fresh vegetables
rationale: HCAT generic fresh-vegetables class maps directly to archetype 50 'Vegetables / High-Value'.

label: Flowers and ornamental plants
rationale: High-value horticulture, typically drip-irrigated or protected; archetype 50.

label: Temporary grass and green fodder
rationale: Temporary grassland, ryegrass, alfalfa, clover, legumes harvested green: fodder grass, archetype 30 'Pastures & Meadows'.

label: Fallow land
rationale: Not cropped in the reference year; kept as fallback per the brief's 'Other / NaN' rule (conservative: slightly overestimates water demand). See ASSUMPTIONS A1.

label: Strawberries
rationale: Annual high-value soft fruit grown as horticulture; archetype 50.

label: Cucurbits
rationale: Melon, pumpkin/squash, watermelon, courgette: fresh vegetables; archetype 50.

label: Brassicas
rationale: Cabbage, mustard, cress; archetype 50.

label: Alliums
rationale: Garlic, onions; archetype 50.

label: Solanaceous vegetables (aubergine)
rationale: Archetype 50 (representative crop 'Tomato / Pepper').

label: Tomato
rationale: Representative crop of archetype 50.

label: Root vegetables
rationale: Beetroot, carrots, turnips; archetype 50.

label: Leafy vegetables
rationale: Lettuce, spinach; archetype 50.

label: Other arable land crops
rationale: Generic residual class; ~96% are annual forage mixtures in this dataset but the HCAT code itself is generic, so fallback is kept. See ASSUMPTIONS A1.

label: Permanent grassland
rationale: Pasture, meadow and grassland: archetype 30 'Pastures & Meadows'.

label: Permanent crops
rationale: Orchards, berries, nuts, citrus, olives, vineyards, nurseries, unspecified permanent crops: tree and perennial crops, archetype 20 'Orchards & Fruits'.

label: Non-grazable shrubland ('wire_bush')
rationale: Coded under permanent crops by EuroCrops, but the national land-cover class is forest/shrubland ('Superficie arbustiva nao pastoreavel'); not an irrigated crop.

label: Forestry
rationale: Trees, woodland, eucalyptus, cork/holm oak stands: not irrigated agriculture.

label: Not known / other
rationale: Unknown crop on land declared agricultural falls back per the brief's 'Other / NaN' rule; non-agricultural land is removed separately by the land-cover filter.
